catastrophe.name: The Fracture
catastrophe.cause: Nuclear war shattered Earth into floating islands.

geography.landform: Fractured continents and floating rock islands above an atmospheric void
geography.boundaries: Map labels mark regions of influence, not surveyed borders.

magnetic_fields.behavior: Erratic and turbulent in motion, but their patterns are predictable.
magnetic_fields.navigation: Ships use magnetic motors to travel through the fields between cities and mining sites.

humanity.adaptation: Survivors evolved over generations under the influence of the magnetic fields.

gravity_and_energy.city_support: Magneton technology stabilizes floating cities and islands, preventing them from falling.
gravity_and_energy.local_gravity: Generated local fields reproduce the experience of the old Earth’s gravity.
gravity_and_energy.power: Oppositely polarized metal components move in magnetic motors, powering city and transport systems.
gravity_and_energy.fictional_physics: These are rules of the setting; no real-world scientific mechanism is established.

society.political_system: Feudal duchies with ruling dukes and barons.
society.origins_of_power: Magneton miners built mining and trading fleets. Control of extraction, ships and trade turned them into the ruling class.

economy.routes: Cities and duchies depend on ships moving between settlements and Magneton mining sites.

society.protection_and_wealth: While Rovan protected merchant and mining ships from pirates, other rulers traded and grew wealthier. His own fleet and resources dwindled.

metals.name: Magneton Type B
metals.ambiguity: The exact division between Type A hull structures and the author-described Type B hull components has not been defined.

metals.name: Magneton Type C
properties: Most malleable of the Magneton types
Impenetrable and impervious to any weapons
metals.availability: Most difficult to find; recently discovered

known_crafting.material_source: Type C taken from the seized Auric Reach Caravan
known_crafting.advantage: The crafted equipment enables the honour guard to drift along magnetic fields and leap between ships.
known_crafting.weapon_vulnerability_status: None established; the author specifies imperviousness to any weapons.
known_crafting.armour_construction: Practical workshop-made brushed silver armour with tool marks, no ceremonial filigree. Continuous coverage without joints or gaps; crimson cloth worn externally.

tesla_guns.description: Fictional electrical weapons carried by armoured soldiers.
tesla_guns.visual_design: Copper coils with green-lit charges; no technical construction recipe is established.

airship_design_language.initial_reference: Long rigid metal Zeppelin-shaped hulls, rounded noses, ribs, portholes, exposed machinery and tail fins.
airship_design_language.additional_reference: Swept lower hulls, open decks, aft superstructures and hull-edge engine machinery.

story_timeline.event: Nuclear war fractures Earth and nearly extinguishes humanity.
Survivors adapt across generations; Magneton emerges from fused nuclear materials.
Magneton power, stabilization, local gravity and transport allow floating cities to grow.
Mining and trade wealth forms the new feudal duchies and barons.
Rovan protects shipping from pirates; other rulers grow rich while his own fleet dwindles.
Rovan and Grievous discuss the city, unpaid soldiers and depleted accounts.
Armoured soldiers board an Auric Reach Caravan with Tesla guns aimed at unarmed sailors. Rovan seizes the ship for unpaid protection fees; his soldiers cheer.
Rovan declares his own future. Seized resources fund recruits and equipment; trained veterans drill the new soldiers. He departs with one capital ship.
He raids an Auric Reach baron, seizes ships and captures a city easily through superior training and surprise.
story_timeline.war_context: First organised inter-duchy war since the Fracture; earlier nuclear war and fighting pirates still occurred.

story_timeline.event: Rovan crafts exactly five practical man-made Type C armour-and-weapon sets with distinct helmet shapes and builds, without joints or gaps.
Bronze-armoured troops with crimson base layers run from the fleet onto the docks, through the gate and into the town streets.
Rovan’s fleet and five silver captains attack another small Auric Reach city, fight the town guard with their distinct magnetic weapons and seize the town.
Rovan and General Grievous discuss holding the captured city, repairing seized ships, and training recruits.
Meanwhile the unnamed ruler of Auric Reach orders and dispatches three capital ships toward Rovan.
story_timeline.time_relation: Parallel cutaway to the command-room discussion

panels.caption: The last war.
panels.narration: By the time the guns fell silent, the Earth had broken apart.
panels.image_description: Fractured landmasses suspended in a glowing magnetic field

panels.caption: Fragments of home.
panels.narration: Continents hung in pieces. Magnetic storms lashed the gaps, but beneath the violence ran patterns the survivors could learn.
panels.image_description: Magnetic currents arc between the exposed undersides of floating islands

panels.caption: The people who remained.
panels.narration: They made their homes on whatever ground was left, and learned to watch the sky.
panels.image_description: A small human silhouette standing on a floating island

panels.caption: Generations later.
panels.narration: Children grew up inside the magnetic fields. Their children did too. Slowly, the fields changed them.
panels.image_description: Three generations of survivors study a magnetic sensing instrument in their settlement

panels.caption: Something in the wreckage.
panels.narration: Nuclear materials had fused into a metal no one had seen before.
panels.image_description: Luminous Magneton ore embedded in fractured rock

panels.caption: Magneton.
panels.narration: At first it was a discovery. In time, it would become the one thing no city could live without.
panels.image_description: Two glowing green Type B Magneton cores of opposite polarity inside a precision motor

panels.caption: A way to keep going.
panels.narration: Opposite-polarity Type B cores drove the new motors. For the first time in generations, there was power to spare.
panels.image_description: A floating city built above a glowing Magneton engine

panels.caption: Under the city.
panels.narration: The engines steadied the islands and restored a familiar pull beneath people’s feet.
panels.image_description: People stand upright inside a city gravity-control chamber while fragments float outside

panels.caption: Home, above the clouds.
panels.narration: Streets filled again. Workshops opened. Somewhere below every city, Magneton kept the engines turning.
panels.image_description: A market street powered by green conduits beneath the floating city’s towers

panels.caption: The men who found the metal.
panels.narration: The first barons were miners. They dug out Magneton, built ships and carried it across the broken world.
panels.image_description: A squat Mole mining ship with an ore cassette, drill, and magnetic engines

panels.caption: Routes worth owning.
panels.narration: Trade made them wealthy. Control of the mines made them powerful.
panels.image_description: Ore is unloaded at a mining dock as a proprietor oversees trade

panels.caption: Eight duchies.
panels.narration: Cities gathered under their banners. The old world was gone, but people had found their way back to lords and subjects.
panels.image_description: Mining barons gather in a council chamber overlooking floating cities

panels.caption: Veymarch.
panels.narration: From above, Rovan’s city looked peaceful. He knew how little it would take to lose it.
panels.image_description: Rovan and his general look over a small island city with battered ships. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: The accounts.
panels.narration: Grievous: “The soldiers’ pay is overdue, Your Grace. The repair yards are still waiting too.”
panels.image_description: General Grievous presents the fleet accounts and an almost empty pay chest. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: What protection had cost him.
panels.narration: Rovan: “Their ships got through because ours stood in the way. Now they have full vaults, and I have men waiting for their pay.”
panels.image_description: Duke Rovan Vey turns toward a wealthy Caravan with a decision taking shape. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: An Auric Reach Caravan.
panels.narration: The sailors stopped where they stood. Across the deck, green light gathered in the soldiers’ Tesla guns.
panels.image_description: Bronze-armoured soldiers board a twin-hull Caravan and aim Tesla guns at unarmed sailors. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: A debt comes due.
panels.narration: Rovan: “You sailed under our protection. My soldiers are still waiting to be paid. Until that debt is settled, this ship is mine.”
panels.image_description: Rovan announces the seizure to the merchant captain while his soldiers guard the sailors. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: The answer.
panels.narration: His soldiers cheered. The sailors said nothing. Grievous watched both sides of the deck.
panels.image_description: Soldiers cheer with their Tesla guns raised safely while the civilian crew stands silent. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: His own future.
panels.narration: Rovan: “I’ll define my own future. Set a course for Auric Reach. I’m done waiting for what we’re owed.”
panels.image_description: Rovan declares his own future at the seized Caravan’s chart table. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: Pay. Equipment. Recruits.
panels.narration: The seized cargo gave Rovan something he had been running out of: time. His veterans put it to work on the drill ground.
panels.image_description: Bronze-armoured veterans train new recruits equipped from seized resources. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: One capital ship.
panels.narration: The Bastion led them out. Beside it sailed the seized Caravan, still a merchant vessel, now carrying Rovan’s supplies.
panels.image_description: A single Bastion capital ship departs with the seized merchant Caravan nearby

panels.caption: They had fought pirates before.
panels.narration: An army was different. Since the Fracture, no duchy had faced an organised invasion from another.
panels.image_description: Rovan’s trained bronze-armoured troops surprise an Auric Reach baron’s docks. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: The harbour.
panels.narration: Rovan’s veterans moved before the defenders could settle into their positions. One dock after another changed hands.
panels.image_description: Veteran troops secure captured merchant airships at the baron’s harbour. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: The first city.
panels.narration: It fell faster than Rovan had expected. Training and surprise had won him a harbour, ships and a foothold in Auric Reach.
panels.image_description: Rovan receives the surrender of the captured city alongside disciplined troops. Veymarch military cloth base layers are crimson

panels.caption: In the workshop.
panels.narration: Rovan worked the stolen silver himself. When he finished, there were five sealed suits, five weapon sets, and no metal left for a sixth.
panels.image_description: Rovan privately crafts practical, workshop-made seamless silver Type C armour and the captains’ five different weapon loadouts. Restrained brass edging and a crimson Veymarch broken-shield-and-star badge mark the silver armour.

panels.caption: The Silver Guard.
panels.narration: A lance. A broadsword. Twin blades. A hammer. A scythe. The five captains wore Veymarch’s broken shield over their silver. They were still his soldiers; now they could cross a battlefield as no soldiers ever had.
panels.image_description: Exactly five practical, man-made silver-armoured captains, with distinct helmet shapes and builds, carrying a lance, broadsword, twin swords, war hammer and scythe. Restrained brass edging and a crimson Veymarch broken-shield-and-star badge mark the silver armour.

panels.caption: Another town ahead.
panels.narration: The gangway struck the dock. Boots hammered across it, and the first squad ran for the gate.
panels.image_description: Bronze-armoured Veymarch troops in crimson run across an airship gangway onto the town docks.

panels.caption: Through the arch.
panels.narration:
“Keep moving! Cover the stairs!”
Tesla fire snapped against the stone as the veterans pulled the rest of the squad through.
panels.image_description: Veymarch troops charge through an arched gate while Auric Reach’s navy-and-gold town guards defend the stairs.

panels.caption: Uphill.
panels.narration: At the fountain, the squads split. Beyond the next bend, the town guard was waiting behind a barricade.
panels.image_description: An overhead view of bronze-and-crimson troops running uphill through town toward a guarded barricade.

panels.caption: The lance fired first.
panels.narration: Magnetic lines tightened around its tip. Then the gathered force struck the guard’s position like a cannon shot.
panels.image_description: A silver captain fires a magnetic condenser lance at a fortified town-guard emplacement as Rovan’s one capital ship and smaller vessels attack the floating city. Restrained brass edging and a crimson Veymarch broken-shield-and-star badge mark the silver armour.

panels.caption: Steel gave way.
panels.narration: The broadsword’s field swelled beyond its blade. One swing opened the ship’s hull, and Rovan’s soldiers rushed the breach.
panels.image_description: A seamless silver knight enlarges an machined broadsword with condensed magnetic fields and cuts a defending ship’s bronze hull as infantry fight for the docks. Restrained brass edging and a crimson Veymarch broken-shield-and-star badge mark the silver armour.

panels.caption: Above the streets.
panels.narration: The twin-blade captain climbed on the magnetic wind, turned in the air, and swept down over the guards.
panels.image_description: A silver captain flies above the town guard with one curved wind sword in each hand, trailing magnetic currents over the occupied streets. Restrained brass edging and a crimson Veymarch broken-shield-and-star badge mark the silver armour.

panels.caption: Behind the hammer.
panels.narration: The hammer hit the paving. A field rose around the advancing troops, and the guards’ Tesla fire broke against it.
panels.image_description: A seamless silver captain strikes the street with a war hammer, raising a magnetic dome that shields crimson-clad troops from the town guard’s green Tesla fire. Restrained brass edging and a crimson Veymarch broken-shield-and-star badge mark the silver armour.

panels.caption: The last leap.
panels.narration: Two points of magnetic energy flared. The scythe captain stepped between them and stood on the command terrace. Below, the guards began laying down their guns. The town was Rovan’s.
panels.image_description: A silver scythe captain jumps between two concentrated magnetic nodes into the command terrace while the town guard surrenders and Veymarch soldiers take control. Restrained brass edging and a crimson Veymarch broken-shield-and-star badge mark the silver armour.

panels.caption: After the fighting.
panels.narration:
Grievous: “We’ve taken the town. Holding it will be another matter.”
Rovan: “Then get the repair yards working. Keep the recruits training. We start there.”
panels.image_description: Rovan and General Grievous plan their next steps, with crimson-clad Veymarch soldiers at the captured city’s command room

panels.caption: In Auric Reach.
panels.narration: The ruler of Auric Reach: “Three capital ships. Send them after Rovan.”
panels.image_description: The unnamed ruler of Auric Reach orders three capital ships toward Rovan beneath the gold banner

panels.caption: Orders already given.
panels.narration: Three great hulls slipped their moorings. While Rovan planned his next move, the ships sent to stop him were already on their way.
panels.image_description: Exactly three Auric Reach capital ships depart together under gold and navy standards, heading toward Rovan

page_canvas.layout: Priority-weighted ordered comic rows with a maximum of five images. Each image is uniformly scaled and translated into the space between the text overlays, preserving its aspect ratio without cropping or distortion.

panel_priority.meaning: Higher values request larger panels. Reading order remains the JSON order.

terms.Magneton: Family of metals formed from nuclear materials after the Fracture.
terms.Duchy: Grouping of floating cities within the new feudal order.
terms.Baron: A ruler whose power grew from Magneton extraction, ships and trade.
terms.Capital ship: The rarest and most expensive military airship class.
terms.Magnetic motor: An engine using opposing polarities in city and transport systems.

canon_constraints: There is one available story entry, Prologue, with twelve pages and 37 distinct panel images.
Rovan begins the campaign with exactly one capital ship; the seized Caravan is a merchant vessel.
The first city capture precedes the crafting of silver honour-guard equipment.
There are exactly five complete Type C armour-and-weapon sets and no material for a sixth.
Type C is impervious to any weapons; no weapon vulnerability or armour-piercing exception is established.
Only Rovan knows the crafting secret through his experience.
Veymarch soldiers wear crimson red cloth base layers under bronze or silver armour.
The three newly dispatched capital ships belong to Auric Reach, not Rovan. No result of their encounter is established.
The five honour-guard captains have practical, man-made continuous silver armour with no joints or gaps. Crimson cloth rests over the sealed metal.
Each captain has one distinct loadout: magnetic lance, field broadsword, twin wind swords, shield war hammer or magnetic scythe.
Page 11 shows a second Auric Reach town seized after Type C is crafted; page 8’s first capture still occurs before the crafting.
Page 9 introduces the five Silver Guard captains; page 10 shows ordinary troops running into the town; page 11 shows the captains’ assault and capture.
All comic pages use the same 1000 by 1400 logical canvas and a maximum of five panels.
The Silver Guard wear Veymarch’s established broken-shield-and-star crest; restrained brass trim does not replace the silver Type C material.
